tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. The cream paper of the menu board.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and inputs that sit on surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and resting borders of cards and unselected chips.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on surface. Also the bold outline (stroke-bold) around pills and primary buttons.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface: Thai sub-names, captions, timestamps.

tokens.name: ink-fixed
tokens.usage: Text on butter and apricot in both themes. Those grounds stay light in dark mode, so their text never flips.

tokens.name: brick
tokens.usage: The brand colour: the menu board's header band. Primary buttons, prices, category headings. Text in brick passes 4.5:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: brick-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed state of brick buttons, and error text (wrong password).

tokens.name: on-brick
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brick fill.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: The 'OPEN AT' pill. Selected chips, secondary buttons, the 'new order' badge. Always with ink-fixed text and a stroke-bold ink outline.

tokens.name: apricot
tokens.usage: The logo's background. Photo placeholders for drinks with no picture, and the 'making' badge. Text on it is ink-fixed.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: The logo lettering. Used sparingly: links, the table number, the initial on a photo placeholder.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: The green stripes of the logo's shirt. Only means done or ready: the 'done' badge and success messages.

tokens.name: on-leaf
tokens.usage: Text on a leaf fill.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The shop name only, set in capitals like the menu board.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Category headings in capitals, in brick.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: ตะกร้าของคุณ
styles.usage: Page and sheet titles. Thai falls back to Kanit.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: เลือกความหวานได้ 4 ระดับ
styles.usage: Default running text. Never smaller than 16px on the customer's phone.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: ชาไทย · หวานน้อย · 2 แก้ว
styles.usage: Thai sub-names under drink names, order lines, captions.

styles.name: item
styles.usage: Drink names, slightly tracked like the menu board.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Latin capitals only (section labels, the open-hours pill). Never track Thai text.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices and totals, with tabular figures, in brick.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a drink name and its Thai sub-name.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of cards and badges.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter and gap between menu cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between option groups in the drink sheet.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between menu categories.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Photos inside cards, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menu cards and order tickets.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Header band corner and bottom sheets, like the menu board's rounded header.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips and badges. The outlined pill is the brand's signature shape.

tokens.name: stroke-bold
tokens.usage: The ink outline around the butter pill and primary buttons.

tokens.name: stroke-mid
tokens.usage: Selected chips and stepper buttons.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Card borders and dividers, in line.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: A hard, offset shadow under primary buttons, like a sticker. Never blurred; nothing else gets a shadow.
